# AbstractAssistant

> Gateway-native desktop assistant for AbstractFramework. It runs as a macOS-first tray app with a
> compact top-right palette and a small CLI. AbstractGateway owns workflows, multimodal defaults,
> durable runs, and media routing; the desktop app owns local UX state, mic capture, playback,
> downloads, and optional hotkey preferences.

Key facts:

- CLI entrypoints: `assistant` and `abstractassistant`
- Default gateway URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8080`
- Connection settings come from `--gateway-url`, `--gateway-token`, or matching environment variables
- Published assistant workflow: `abstractassistant-orchestrator`
- Multimodal defaults are edited through gateway capability-default routes, not local config files
- Local data lives under `~/.abstractassistant/`
- Preferred validation: `python -m pytest abstractassistant/tests/basic abstractassistant/tests/integration -q`
- Regenerate the full bundle with `python scripts/update_llms_full.py`

## Context

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/llms-full.txt): expanded bundle of the core docs and gateway-native assistant code.

## Core code

- [abstractassistant/cli.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/abstractassistant/cli.py): tray and terminal entrypoints.
- [abstractassistant/config.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/abstractassistant/config.py): gateway URL/token resolution.
- [abstractassistant/gateway/client.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/abstractassistant/gateway/client.py): gateway HTTP client.
- [abstractassistant/ui/gateway_worker.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/abstractassistant/ui/gateway_worker.py): run launch, history replay, waits, and streaming.
- [abstractassistant/core/gateway_voice_manager.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/abstractassistant/core/gateway_voice_manager.py): local mic/playback plus gateway STT/TTS routing.
- [abstractassistantv2/app.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/abstractassistantv2/app.py): tray and palette shell.
- [abstractassistantv2/controller.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/abstractassistantv2/controller.py): controller for sessions, workflow resolution, preferences, and route defaults.
- [abstractassistantv2/gateway.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/abstractassistantv2/gateway.py): workflow-catalog and capability-default helpers.
- [abstractassistantv2/preferences.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/abstractassistantv2/preferences.py): durable local UX preferences.

## Tests

- [tests/basic/test_assistant_v2.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/tests/basic/test_assistant_v2.py): v2 workflow, preferences, and gateway-worker contract coverage.
- [tests/basic/test_cli_gateway_mode.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/tests/basic/test_cli_gateway_mode.py): CLI gateway-mode parsing and tray launch behavior.
- [tests/basic/test_gateway_client_methods.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/tests/basic/test_gateway_client_methods.py): gateway client route coverage.
- [tests/integration/test_agent_host_tool_wait_resume.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lpalbou/AbstractAssistant/main/tests/integration/test_agent_host_tool_wait_resume.py): durable wait/resume behavior still expected by the desktop shell.
